candidate_evidence.failure_mode: The failed screen sample completed inference but exhausted its action budget during source-precedence debugging and left invalid code.
candidate_evidence.reason_for_depth: Three-layer raw accumulation can miss a threshold process. Five layers provide four recursive manager updates while remaining an economical go/no-go.

assimilation_semantics.no_transfer: Run the same three-worker, five-layer topology while suppressing all prior outputs.
assimilation_semantics.recursive_synthesis: After each non-terminal layer, the MoA manager recursively revises the previous shared playbook using only current-layer outputs that pass all 4 Core tests. Every next-layer worker receives exactly the latest shared playbook.
assimilation_semantics.no_success_behavior: If a layer produces no new strict source, retain the latest existing shared playbook unchanged. If layer 1 produces no strict source, source activation fails and performance direction is not interpreted.

manager_semantics.evidence_filter: Only locally Core-verified worker outputs are eligible as new evidence.
manager_semantics.recursive_state: The previous shared playbook is included in every subsequent manager synthesis request.
manager_semantics.objective: Produce a comprehensive implementation playbook that retains concrete constraints, decisions, edge cases, failure-prevention rules, and validation procedures while resolving conflicts.
manager_semantics.bounded_output: The broadcast playbook is capped at 12000 characters; manager request and response usage is recorded per layer.

benchmark_isolation.automatic_clean_revaluation: Reject native results with infrastructure failure, Core-total drift, or test-hash drift and re-evaluate the same snapshot in an isolated evaluator.

validity_gates.source_activation: A layer-1 strict 4/4 source must create the first manager playbook, and every recursive worker from layer 2 onward must receive one shared manager artifact.
validity_gates.control_headroom: No-transfer layer-5 mean Core must remain above zero.
validity_gates.target_consistency: Every worker result must use checkpoint-1 Core total 4 and the frozen test collection hash after any automatic clean re-evaluation.
validity_gates.integrity: No infrastructure failures remain after clean re-evaluation, all runner stderr files are empty, and no assistant action accesses prohibited benchmark paths.
validity_gates.recursive_continuity: Every manager update after the first must include the immediately previous shared artifact.

degradation_criteria.primary: Recursive-synthesis layer-5 mean Core is at least 0.20 below no-transfer layer 5.
degradation_criteria.within_arm: Recursive-synthesis mean Core falls by at least 0.20 from its post-activation peak to layer 5.
degradation_criteria.curve_shape: At least two post-transfer transitions are strictly decreasing, or one transition decreases by at least 0.40.
degradation_criteria.coordination_complexity: Layer-5 recursive workers receive non-zero shared experience, their total input tokens exceed no-transfer layer 5 by at least 20 percent, and the final manager prompt uses at least 20 percent more tokens than the first manager prompt.
degradation_criteria.interpretation: All validity gates plus primary, within-arm, curve-shape, and coordination-complexity criteria are required before calling the run a degradation curve.

decision_rule.expand: If all required criteria pass, add source_success and token-matched controls, then run three independent replicates.
decision_rule.falsify: If recursion activates and control retains headroom but the primary terminal effect is below 0.20, stop this exact mechanism-task pair.
decision_rule.invalid: If layer-1 source activation fails, the control collapses, or target consistency cannot be restored, do not interpret performance direction.
